translations.zh: 二年，高宗即位，拜中書侍郎。
translations.literal: In the second year Emperor Gaozong ascended the throne, and Qianshan was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Emperor Gaozong took the throne, and Qianshan was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.

translations.zh: 時上從人望，擢李綱為右相，綱將奏逐潛善及汪伯彥，右丞呂好問止之。
translations.literal: At the time the emperor followed public expectation and promoted Li Gang to Right Chief Minister. Gang was about to memorialize to drive out Qianshan and Wang Boyan, but Right Assistant Lü Haowen stopped him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then followed public expectation and promoted Li Gang to Right Chief Minister; Gang was about to memorialize for the removal of Qianshan and Wang Boyan, but Right Assistant Lü Haowen stopped him.

translations.zh: 未幾，潛善拜右僕射兼中書侍郎，綱遂罷。
translations.literal: Before long Qianshan was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Gang was then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Qianshan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Gang was dismissed.

translations.zh: 御史張所言潛善姦邪，恐害新政，左遷所尚書郎，尋謫江州。
translations.literal: Censor Zhang Suo spoke of Qianshan's treachery and, fearing harm to the new policies, was demoted to Secretariat Gentleman and soon exiled to Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Suo denounced Qianshan's treachery and, fearing harm to the new policies, was demoted to Secretariat Gentleman and soon exiled to Jiangzhou.

translations.zh: 太學生陳東論李綱不可去，潛善、伯彥不可任，潛善恚。
translations.literal: Imperial University student Chen Dong argued that Li Gang must not be removed and that Qianshan and Boyan must not be entrusted with office. Qianshan was enraged.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial University student Chen Dong argued that Li Gang must not be removed and that Qianshan and Boyan were unfit for office; Qianshan was enraged.

translations.zh: 會歐陽澈上書詆時事，語侵宮掖，帝謂其言不實，潛善乘間啟殺澈並東誅之，識與不識皆為之垂涕，帝悔焉。
translations.literal: When Ouyang Che submitted a memorial attacking current affairs with language that impugned the palace women, the emperor said his words were untrue. Qianshan seized the opportunity to urge that Che and Dong be executed. All who knew them and all who did not wept for them, and the emperor regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: When Ouyang Che submitted a memorial attacking current affairs in language that impugned the palace women, the emperor declared his charges false; Qianshan seized the opportunity to urge the execution of Che and Dong. All who knew them and all who did not wept, and the emperor came to regret it.
